title: Steam
description: A speckled stoneware cup of black coffee on its saucer, on a studio sweep that falls from pale light into warm shade behind the cup. Steam rises in three loose ribbons that sway most at the top; move across it and it bends away along your breath, curls, rises with the kink still in it, then straightens.
intent: A quiet still life with one living part: steam you can blow on, drawn from a velocity field that forgets you a second later.

sources.name: Bruno Simon, My Room in 3D, coffee steam
sources.what: Read for the idea only (no licence): noise alpha scrolling upward, sway that grows with the square of height so only the top moves, and a soft edge fade. Re-derived as three screen-space plumes.

sources.name: OGL, Flowmap
sources.what: The flowmap technique: a 128 square ping-pong field that decays each frame, a velocity stamp with a smoothstep falloff around the pointer, and pointer velocity eased in at 0.5 and out at 0.1. Re-implemented in three.js with time-based decay and an upward advection so a breath travels up the plume; the steam is sampled upstream of the flow so it bends along it.

sources.name: three.js
sources.what: Lathe and tube geometry for the cup, saucer and handle, a custom sweep backdrop, physical glaze, PMREM window reflections, soft shadow maps.
